candidates.summary: Kola-Ha Warform supernatural-looking tags/effects remain biotech-boundary proposals.
Soul fragments, pacts, curses and portal-market mechanics remain Black-Vegas-scoped proposals.
Divine resonance, cleansing ritual and vision mechanics remain proposals.
Goblin magical artifacts, potions and portal context remain proposals.
Raven Stones, psychic beacons, Dissonance, reality editing and time-sealing remain proposals.
Blood mysticism, curses, spirit/undead systems, soul-bound technology and ritual warfare remain proposals.
Spirit Communion, omens, rituals and spirit-facing abilities remain proposals.
Psychic/radiant/force effects and spell-absorption language remain biotech-boundary proposals.
Structured arcana, resonance, chaos cults, dreamcasting and wild-magic context remain proposals.
Outlaw magitech, forbidden portals, soul-fracture and arcane/temporal signatures remain proposals.
Ritual glyphs, hymns, ghost-market and dream-responsive supernatural hooks remain proposals.
Trickster-god, narrative-magic, god-fragment and spacetime-wound models remain alternate proposals.
Soul anchors, demonic pacts, branded rituals, corruption and infernal portal mechanics remain proposals.
Dark-magic resistance, corruption detection, anti-possession/scrying and portal-sensing mechanics remain proposals.
Magical byway influence and varying environmental/magical laws remain spatial/worldbuilding proposals.
Assistant-generated mana names, multipliers, effects, rarities and leyline claims remain proposals beneath the owner requirement for multiple mana types.
Local spells, divine/fate quest authority, soul qualities, respawn/reincarnation and magic-dependent process mechanics remain proposals.
Assistant priest/mystic/prophecy role material remains proposal-only; Ocularum mechanism stays unresolved.

authority_boundaries.rule: Owner-authored statements and explicit owner corrections outrank surrounding assistant-generated supernatural prose.
Source artifact, tradition/source family, effect/subtype family, runtime concept and canonical owner domain remain distinct MSS-01 axes.
MSS-02 remains resource/capacity/cost/strain/overreach owner; no recovered universal mana, charge, fatigue, strain, backlash or conversion formula is inferred.
MSS-03 and Action/Event remain supernatural resolution owners; recovered prose does not directly mutate damage, healing, targeting, saves or conditions.
MSS-04 Rune Construction remains authoritative; recovered glyphs, sigils and runes do not enter the governed 34-rune grammar by terminology alone.
MSS-05 remains completed_verified; recovered proposals may be authoring/research references only and do not become accepted outputs.
MIB-11 owns destinations, worlds, timelines, eras and branches even when portals or temporal effects are supernatural.
Character authority owns abilities, capacities, conditions, progression and access; RSR-07 creates no Character ability state.
D17/Item-Asset owns enchanted objects, spellbooks, charge holders and instances; RSR-07 creates no item state.
Kola-Ha Forms/Warforms remain CCP/DPL biotech unless later evidence explicitly crosses into MSS; shared strain/resonance words are insufficient.
Owner requires multiple mana types with source, comparative value, unique effects and rarity; assistant-generated names/values remain proposals.
Owner Pencrona inter-era portal and chronology facts are preserved, but no chronal/paradox mechanics are invented and MIB-11 stays authoritative.
Owner Age-of-Orilaun 30 Winds portal-travel facts are preserved while later New Tokyo/Dominix or lost Consortium-origin knowledge stays hidden from the in-era view.
Owner Serpent telepathy/negative-emotion and suppressed-human-potential evidence is preserved without inferring a psychic resource, telepathy formula or deity system.
Owner Ocularum cross-reality viewing/piloting function is preserved while its mechanism remains unresolved rather than classified as magic, portal, divine or technology.
Owner Helldiving trans-portal support intent is preserved; specific soul, infernal, ritual, corruption and numeric mechanics remain proposals.
No new MSS stable identity is created merely from recovered prose; existing owners/IDs must be reused when later supported.
Routing to MSS-06..12 identifies later owning review only and grants no implementation authority before RSR-07 closeout.
